parsed.internal_thinking: I have 2 Wood and 1 Sheep. Alice and Charlie are colluding against me, and the Brick 6 is blocked by the robber, which is my primary source of Brick. Alice has 3 Wood, 1 Brick, and 1 Wheat, while Charlie has 3 Wood and 1 Brick. Both need Wheat. I cannot build anything or buy a development card right now. My best move is to attempt a trade to get Brick or Wheat, though it is unlikely to be accepted given the current table sentiment. I'll offer my Wood for Brick to see if anyone budges, then end my turn.
parsed.note_to_self: Brick 6 is still blocked. I need a 7 or a Knight to move the robber. Alice and Charlie are still refusing to trade fairly.
parsed.say_outloud: Tough luck on the wheat, Alice. I'm in the same boat. Charlie, you've got plenty of wood already, but if you want to swap a brick for some of mine to help your road, I'm open to it.
